lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a series of approximately five vertical columns of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the branchial region, arranged in a staggered grid with 3-5 spots per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of slightly higher pixel intensity align with the vertical rows of blobs, creating a structured grid pattern across the lateral mid-section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: At least three horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by high-luminance upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Fine, high-luminance linear markings resembling superficial abrasions are visible on the dorsal surface of the head anterior to the primary spot pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: Projected caustic light patterns on the dorsal-anterior surface and multiple small, dark, elongated biological attachments near the pectoral fin base.
